Aisha: Heads-up — Skylark QBR Thu 10am PT. Need final slides + risk matrix by EOD Wed. cc @Olivia @Ben
Ben: On it. I'll update the renewal slide and draft the exec asks. Need ARR / usage numbers from @Elena.
Elena: Pulling ARR + 90d usage trend now, will drop CSV to #cs-data by 15:00 PT.
Ravi: Taking infra & model perf notes — will add latency/cost analysis + top 3 incidents.
Marta: Can we run a 20-min enablement pre-brief for their product team? Proposed Wed 16:00 PT rehearsal.
Olivia: :thumbsup: Wed 16:00 works for execs. Execs want a 1-page summary: wins + risks + asks.
Aisha: Core action items: 1) Slides collated in /drive/qbr/skylark 2) One-pager by @Ben 3) Runbook + owners by @Ravi 4) Enablement dry-run by @Marta 5) Renewal risk narrative draft by me (Aisha).
Ben: Adding one-pager now. Quick Q — legal sign-off needed for the pilot ask? cc @Elena
Elena: Legal not required for ask framing; escalate if contract changes are requested. I'll annotate risk level & churn indicators.
janitor-bot: Reminder: file upload detected in #customer-success at 2026-03-20T15:01:12Z
Aisha: Ben — please add a tiny slide on 'cost per inference' impact. Execs care about unit economics.
Ben: Will do. Need per-model token counts and recent throughput from @Ravi.
Ravi: Snippet for slide: `avg latency 120ms -> 95ms after cache`; will include model token breakdown.
Marta: Dry-run RSVP: @Aisha @Ben @Ravi @Olivia — confirm Wed 16:00–16:30 PT?
Olivia: I'll join Wed 16:00–16:10 for the exec summary. If conflict, record and I can review.
Aisha: Noted a renewal risk — Skylark shows ~30% usage dip in last month. @Elena can you confirm root cause?
Elena: Investigating: looks like a single heavy job reduced batch sizes. Pulling session logs, ETA 17:00 PT.
Ben: Proposed mitigation: pilot a cost optimization to reduce spend without feature loss — we'll pitch as a win-win.
Aisha: Good. I'll capture CSM survey sentiment bullets for the 'health' slide.
Olivia: For the exec ask, keep to 3 asks max: 1) pricing pilot, 2) dedicated throughput for peak days, 3) 2-week intensified support window.
Ravi: I'll add an appendix with technical fallbacks if pilot shows regressions (routing tweaks, kv-cache tuning).
Aisha: Final checklist: slides by EOD Wed; rehearsal Wed 16:00 PT; final deck to execs Thu 08:00 PT. Who can't make rehearsal?
Ben: All good from me.
Marta: :raised_hands: confirmed.
Elena: Delivering numbers to #cs-data by 15:00, will update thread after digging in.
Olivia: Thanks team — please surface any red flags ASAP. I'll prep the opening 2 slides for execs.
Aisha: Adding compact action table below:
- Action: One-pager + deck edits -> Owner: Ben -> Due: Wed EOD
- Action: ARR & usage CSV -> Owner: Elena -> Due: Wed 15:00 PT
- Action: Infra/latency slides + runbook -> Owner: Ravi -> Due: Wed 18:00 PT
- Action: Enablement dry-run + notes -> Owner: Marta -> Due: Wed 16:30 PT
- Action: Renewal risk narrative -> Owner: Aisha -> Due: Wed EOD
Aisha: I'll check in tomorrow morning and merge final deck. Ping me in thread with any blockers. Thanks!
